title: What Flint is using in this conversation
description: What is available to Flint, what was chosen for a request, and what is verified in the sanitized copy of the last request. Changes here affect future messages, not a reply already being written.

contextWindow.title: Context window
contextWindow.meter: About {{percent}} percent of the context window used

state.pending-next-message: Will be sent with your next message

location.local: Runs on this device or your network. Messages do not leave it.
location.remote: Remote provider: your messages and included files are sent to it.
location.checking: Still checking where this provider runs.
location.unknown: Where this provider runs could not be determined.

reason.assistantInstructions: The assistant's instructions are sent as the system prompt.
reason.pendingInline: Its text will be placed into your next message.
reason.pendingEmbeddings: It will be indexed; Flint reads the relevant parts only when it searches.
reason.retrievalNotRecorded: Indexed for search. Which parts Flint read is not recorded; only files it searched could have been used.
reason.temporaryChat: Temporary chats neither read nor save memory.
reason.memoryNotSentYet: No message has been sent from this window yet, so no memory selection is known. Saved memories are not all sent: Flint picks the ones that apply.
reason.memoryConflicts: Memories that contradict each other are withheld until you resolve them.
reason.memoryDropped: Applicable memories that did not fit in the budget were left out.
reason.modelWithoutTools: The selected model does not support tools, so none are offered.
reason.toolFromServer: Offered to the model from this connection. Flint asks before using tools that need permission.
reason.toolBuiltIn: A built-in tool offered to the model.
reason.toolsTurnedOff: Tools you turned off are not offered in any conversation.
reason.inlineSent: Its text was placed into the message that attached it. Whether that message was still in the last request is not verified.
reason.inlineVerified: Its file id is present in the sanitized copy of the last request.
reason.memoryIncludedVerified: Chosen for the last request, and its id is present in the sanitized copy of that request.
reason.memorySelectedUnverified: Chosen for the last request. The sanitized copy has not been checked, so inclusion is not verified.
reason.memoryNotInSnapshot: Chosen for the last request, but its id was not found in the sanitized copy of that request.
reason.memoryRetrievedNotChosen: Applies to this conversation, but another memory or the space limit kept it out of the last request.
reason.memoryDisabled: Memory is turned off in Settings, so no saved memory was read for the last request.
reason.memoryUnavailable: Memory could not be read for the last request, so none was sent.
reason.toolInRequest: Declared to the model in the sanitized copy of the last request.
reason.toolNotInLastRequest: Not declared in the last request.
reason.toolAdvertisedUnverified: Flint offered it with the last request. The sanitized copy has not been checked.
reason.noRequestYet: No message has been sent from this conversation in this session, so there is no request to describe.
reason.requestFailed: The request did not get a response from the provider.
reason.snapshotPending: Flint has not yet received the reference to the sanitized copy of this request.
reason.snapshotRecorded: A sanitized copy of this request was recorded.
reason.snapshotVerified: The sanitized copy of this request was read back and used to check the items above.

snapshotUnavailable.not-captured: No sanitized copy was recorded for this request, so nothing above is marked as verified.
snapshotUnavailable.not-serializable: The request could not be serialized, so no copy was stored.
snapshotUnavailable.too-large: The request was too large to store whole.
snapshotUnavailable.missing: The sanitized copy is no longer on disk (it may have expired or been deleted).
snapshotUnavailable.error: The sanitized copy could not be read.

reason.usageRecorded: The provider reported token usage, recorded against this request.

label.temporary: Memory is off in temporary chats
label.notSentYet: Nothing sent from this window yet

empty.noInstructions: No assistant instructions. Normal conversations do not read project instruction files such as Flint.md; Cowork does.
empty.noAttachments: No files are attached to this conversation.
empty.indexUnavailable: Indexed files could not be listed.
empty.noMemory: No saved memory applied to the last message.

memoryScopeNote: Editing or forgetting a memory affects future messages only.

notice.projectChanged: The last request used memory from {{previous}}. This conversation now uses {{current}}, which applies from your next message.
notice.adapterBoundary: Verified means present in the sanitized request Flint sent. The provider or local engine may still change it after that, for example by applying the model's chat template.

cards.changesSession: Diff sizes are known for edits made since Flint started.
